note: Pictures and clips made with Grok (grok CLI: image_gen, then image_to_video on that picture). No people, no text, no logos, no real brands.
style: dark cyberpunk industrial, magenta and cyan neon against black steel, rain, volumetric fog, cinematic, no people, no text, no logos, no brand marks

shots.image: Cyberpunk megacity at night seen from a rain-soaked elevated highway, industrial smokestacks and chrome towers, magenta and cyan neon haze, volumetric fog, cinematic wide shot
shots.motion: Camera glides fast forward along the wet highway toward the city, rain streaks, neon reflections sliding past, smoke drifting

shots.image: Extreme close-up of a huge chrome and black steel combustion engine block in a dark industrial garage, glowing magenta-hot exhaust headers, cyan indicator lights, oil sheen, sparks in the air, shallow depth of field
shots.motion: The engine runs hard: parts vibrate, exhaust headers pulse brighter, sparks and heat haze rise, slow push-in

shots.image: Sleek unbranded matte-black futuristic sports car seen from the rear three-quarter, parked at the mouth of a wet neon-lit tunnel, cyan underglow, magenta tail lights, steam on the ground
shots.motion: The car launches forward into the tunnel, tail lights leaving long streaks, spray from the wet road, camera follows low behind

shots.image: Vast industrial foundry interior at night, rows of robotic arms welding steel frames, showers of orange sparks, molten metal glow, cyan haze and magenta warning lights, heavy machinery silhouettes
shots.motion: Robotic arms move and weld in rhythm, sparks burst and fall, molten glow flickers, slow lateral tracking shot

shots.image: First-person view at high speed inside a hexagonal industrial tunnel lined with magenta and cyan light strips, wet road, motion blur, vanishing point dead centre
shots.motion: Hurtling forward through the tunnel at extreme speed, light strips streaming past, slight camera shake

shots.image: Gigantic turbine reactor core in a dark steel chamber, concentric rings of blades, cyan plasma glowing at the centre, magenta sparks arcing, catwalks for scale
shots.motion: The turbine rings spin faster and faster, plasma core pulsing, sparks arcing outward, slow push-in

shots.image: Aerial view over an endless cyberpunk industrial megacity at night, layered elevated roads with streams of vehicle lights, refinery towers venting flame, magenta and cyan signage glow without readable text, low clouds
shots.motion: Slow flyover across the city, streams of lights flowing along the roads, flames flickering on towers, clouds drifting

shots.image: Unbranded matte-black futuristic sports car parked on a rooftop edge overlooking a cyberpunk industrial city at first light, engine off, thin steam rising from the hood, pale magenta dawn on the horizon, puddles
shots.motion: Very slow push-in, steam rising from the hood, city lights fading as dawn brightens, a few birds or drones far away
